title: The BOINC server's committed settings, contrib-compute/infra/boinc/env/<env>.json
description: Public settings that scripts/provision-boinc.sh deploys as the stack usnm-boinc-<env> into usnm-boinc-rg-<env>, and scripts/build-boinc-images.sh updates with the images it builds. Nothing secret belongs here: the secrets are made in Azure (contrib-compute/infra/boinc/modules/keyvault.bicep). Keys sorted. provision-boinc.sh checks the same rules with jq.

assessment.description: Run the server from the bridge image (the server image plus usnm-boinc), so the usnm_assess and usnm_gold validators can run: main.bicep's assessment parameter.

codeSignPublicKey.description: The PUBLIC half of the offline code-signing key (code_sign_public), as text. Empty until it is made on the offline machine. The private half never comes here or to Azure.

goldBundle.description: Deploy the gold bundle job, which builds the gold bundle v1 from its publishers onto the share inside the VNet (docs/boinc.md#build-the-gold-bundle): main.bicep's goldBundle parameter.

images.description: Images by registry digest, or empty before the first build. server and bridge are in the app's shared registry (infra/names/<env>.json) and come from scripts/build-boinc-images.sh; with server empty, the stack deploys only the base resources. worker is the public GHCR package that volunteers pull (ADR-0019, addendum), from .github/workflows/boinc-worker.yml. appver is the last published app version (images/appver, usnm-boinc-appver), written by scripts/boinc-app-release.sh; when set, the stack keeps the publish job on it.

web.description: Optional web/daemon image override, preserving additive production images independently of lifecycle jobs. New normal builds update it to the rebuilt bridge; absent or empty uses assessment selection.

keyVaultAllowedIps.description: Public IPv4 addresses (the home network) the BOINC Key Vault admits on its public endpoint, behind its firewall and a policy exemption for that vault alone (#917, 20 October 2026). Empty or absent: private-only. main.bicep's keyVaultAllowedIps parameter.

location.description: Azure region; the resource group's own.

onPremGroupId.description: Object id of usnm-onprem-grp-<env> (the on-prem hosts' Arc identities): Key Vault Secrets User on the project vault, so the on-prem BOINC server reads the project secrets (#942). main.bicep's onPremGroupId.

operator.description: The Entra user or group that gets Key Vault Secrets Officer, Log Analytics Reader on the stack workspace, and is named as the MySQL Entra administrator in the printed step.

projectShare.description: The project share's billing (#917): standard (pay-as-you-go StorageV2), copy (the provisioned v2 SSD share also mounted at /project-v2 to fill it), provisioned (/project is the provisioned share; the old account kept for rollback), provisioned-final (the old account removed). main.bicep's projectShare parameter; docs/boinc.md, "Moving the project share".

projectUrl.description: The BOINC master URL. Permanent once volunteers attach.

qualityWave.description: Deploy the usnm_quality wave job (usnm-boinc-quality-caj-<env>): it downloads the runner with the BOINC identity, refuses it unless its sha256 matches, and runs its eight shards. scripts/boinc-quality-campaign.py launch-corpus uploads scripts/boinc/quality_corpus_runner.py as quality/<campaign>/run_wave9-<first 12 of its sha256>.py and prints this setting when the job pins another. Absent: no job. main.bicep's qualityWaveScript and qualityWaveScriptSha256.

script.description: The script's blob URL, read with the BOINC identity.

sha256.description: The script's sha256; the job stops on any other.

requireSecureTransport.description: Require verified MySQL TLS. Defaults OFF when absent. Set true only after #464 actual Azure-chain, complete copied-project migration/rollback and all-client acceptance, under #529 coordination. Forwarded by normal provisioning; no portal-only toggle.
